fetch.description: Read the opcode at the head into the instruction register, keep a copy in OPCODE, and move the head on

While N is clear, carry the next n cells along to the tail without running them, and keep HATCH; when N is set, hatch them: run on into them, and HATCH is not kept. Flags and A are left as they were. n must be at least 1
